description: Follow syrup rivers, elite taffy crews, and the Confectioner boss. Opponent Level now ramps per zone instead of a flat Lv 12, matching the sharper Level curve (GROWTH_PER_LEVEL 0.09).
title: The Sugarworks
tone: bright anime adventure without parodying other monster franchises
zones: Gumdrop Yard — introductory battles and recovery
Caramel Foundry — elite teams and shop nodes
Peppermint Furnace — miniboss pressure before the boss gate
